results.name: FREE Caramel Coffee Frappe 3D Prop
results.description:
A richly detailed 3D model of an iced caramel coffee frappe served in a tall footed glass. Layers of swirled coffee and caramel cream fill the glass, topped with a generous peak of soft whipped cream drizzled with caramel sauce. Garnished with a brown striped straw and a decorative leaf accent. Great for café-themed scenes, dessert shop displays, food prop assets, cozy game environments, or stylized beverage renders.
